title: Bill-wise Details और Outstanding
intro:
भाग 1 — Accounting की नींव

कुल Problems: 3 │ 🟢 1 🟡 1 🟠 1

🎯 इस Chapter में आप सीखेंगे

हर Party के Bills Track करना और Receipt/Payment में Against Reference सही चुनना।

🧭 Tally में रास्ता (Steps)

F11 में Bill-wise Details = Yes

Sale/Purchase में New Ref बनाएँ

Receipt/Payment में Agst Ref चुनकर Clear करें; Advance में New Ref

⚠️ आम गलतियाँ

Payment में Agst Ref की जगह New Ref चुन लेना — Bill खुला रहता है

Bill Name में Space/Spelling का फ़र्क

📌 ज़रूरी नोट

Party Ledger में 'Maintain Balances Bill-by-Bill = Yes' रखें। हर तारीख़ 1st/2nd/Last Date, FY है।

🔥 Warm-Up Drill

Type of Ref पहचानें

हर Situation के सामने सही 'Type of Ref' (New Ref / Advance / Agst Ref / On Account) लिखें।

S.No.Situationआपका उत्तर
1Sale/Purchase Voucher में पहली बार कोई Bill बनाते समय______________
2ग्राहक से माल भेजने से पहले पैसा मिलने पर______________
3किसी पुराने/Pending Bill के विरुद्ध Payment/Receipt Adjust करते समय______________

📘 Practice Problems

हर Problem में करना है: Pass the necessary Vouchers in Tally Prime with Bill-wise Details (New Ref/Agst Ref) and check each Party's outstanding balance.
guide:
Bill-wise Details और Outstanding

हर Problem: क्या करना है → Steps → Entry Table → ✅ Check (उत्तर-कुंजी से मिलान)।

सबसे पहले — Bill-wise की तैयारी

  • F11 (Features) → Maintain Bill-wise Details = Yes।
  • हर Party Ledger में "Maintain balances bill-by-bill" = Yes (Debtors/Creditors में डिफ़ॉल्ट Yes होता है)।
  • Sale/Purchase Voucher में Party चुनते ही Bill-wise Details खुलता है → Type of Ref = New Ref, Name = Bill का नाम/नंबर।
  • Receipt/Payment में Type of Ref = Agst Ref → Pending Bill चुनें → रकम डालें।
  • Outstanding देखने के लिए: Gateway → Display More Reports → Statements of Accounts → Outstandings → Receivables/Payables।
Type of Refकब चुनें
New Refपहली बार बिल बनाते समय (Sale/Purchase)।
Agst Refकिसी पुराने बिल के विरुद्ध Payment/Receipt (पूरी या आंशिक)।
Advanceमाल/सेवा से पहले पैसा लेना या देना।
On Accountजब पता न हो कि किस बिल का पैसा है।

🔥 Warm-Up के उत्तर

No.SituationType of Ref
1Sale/Purchase में पहली बार Bill बनाते समयNew Ref
2माल भेजने से पहले पैसा मिलने परAdvance
3पुराने Pending Bill के विरुद्ध Payment/ReceiptAgst Ref
4जब पता न हो कि Payment किस Bill के लिए हैOn Account

problems.title: Lamp Holder  &  Tube Light — Basic Bill Tracking
problems.q:
🟢 Basic

  • 1st April — Opening: Cash Balance ₹ 25,000; Bank Balance ₹ 35,000
  • 1st April — Purchased from Mr. Hitesh: 200 Pcs Lamp Holder @ ₹20
  • 1st April — Purchased from Mr. Chetan: 100 Pcs Tube Light @ ₹40
  • 1st April — Paid 20 Pcs' amount to Mr. Chetan
  • 2nd April — Paid half amount to Mr. Hitesh
  • 2nd April — Returned to Chetan 15 Pcs Tube Light (reason: out of order)
  • 2nd April — Sold goods to Mr. Mukesh: 5 Pcs Tube Light @ ₹50
  • 2nd April — Purchased from Mr. Hitesh: 50 Pcs Fancy Light @ ₹150
  • 30th April — Sold goods to Mr. Sanjay: 10 Pcs Fancy Light @ ₹200
  • 30th April — Received cheque from Mr. Mukesh for 4 Pcs Tube Light amount
  • 30th April — Received cash from Mr. Sanjay for half of the Fancy Light amount
problems.full:
📌 ध्यान दें

Problem में भुगतान का माध्यम नहीं लिखा, इसलिए मैंने नकद माना है (Mukesh से Cheque Bank में)। Pending Bills पर इसका असर नहीं पड़ता।

🟡 Intermediate

  • 1st April — Purchased 5 Pcs LED 32-inch @ ₹29,000 through ICICI Bank from Mr. Jangid
  • 1st April — Purchased 10 Pcs Refrigerator 225-Ltr @ ₹15,600 from Mr. Rashid
  • 2nd April — Sold 1 Pcs LED 32-inch @ ₹31,200 to Mr. Kunal; payment received in ICICI Bank

problems.title: Mixed Discount  &  Return — Computer Accessories
problems.q:
🟠 Advanced

  • 1st April — Opening: Cash ₹ 90,000; HDFC Bank ₹ 1,50,000
  • 1st April — Purchased Machinery worth ₹ 30,000
  • 1st April — Paid office clerk's salary ₹ 40,000 by HDFC cheque
  • 2nd April — Purchased from Mr. Naresh Chand (Balaji Computer Shop): 10 Pcs Keyboard and 10 Pcs Mouse @ ₹400 each
  • 2nd April — Paid half of each item's amount to Mr. Naresh Chand by cash
  • 2nd April — Returned 2 Pcs Keyboard to Naresh Chand (reason: defective)
  • 2nd April — Sold 4 Pcs Keyboard to Mr. Sujeet @ ₹500
  • 30th April — Sold 5 Pcs Mouse to Mr. Naresh Kumar by cash @ ₹500 (Discount 4%)
  • 30th April — Received amount for 3 Pcs from Mr. Sujeet in HDFC Bank; 1 Pcs returned being defective
  • 30th April — Purchased 10 Card Reader @ ₹40 and 10 (8GB Memory Card) @ ₹180 through HDFC Bank from Mr. Rakesh Telecom
  • 30th April — Withdrew cash from bank ₹ 5,000
problems.full:
📌 ध्यान दें

Machinery खरीद नकद मानी है (कुंजी के Cash ₹63,400 से यही मिलता है)।

Naresh Kumar को नकद बिक्री में 4% Discount: 2,500 − 100 = ₹2,400 नकद आया।

Sujeet: 4 Pcs × 500 = 2,000; 3 Pcs का ₹1,500 आया; 1 Pcs वापस (Credit Note ₹500) → Balance ₹0।
